name: gdn-bole-exact

rows.name: gdn_tree_bole_verify_k128_v128
rows.note: Bole solver. The root is a fixed one-node serial FP32 prefix in the engine's own instruction order; every other node's ancestor walk, contraction and rounded-u feedback accumulate in FP64. The result is therefore NOT bit-identical to a serial replay below the root, and the row does not claim it is.

rows.name: gdn_tree_bole_commit_k128_v128
rows.note: Recomputes u from the original update data [normalized k, conv v, gamma, beta] with the recurrent kernel's FP32 instructions in the serial order, so the committed state equals a serial replay bit for bit. A stored or replayed U is deliberately not used.

selection.reason: opt-in kernel plugin; the engine has no tree-layout seam, so no model selects gdn_tree_bole unless it names this plugin

this_plugin.correctness: see tests/bole_gdn_gpu_test: commit byte-exact to libr4d's GDN row, verify root exact, verify deeper nodes within a declared reorder tolerance, refusals exercised, negative controls fire
